feeds.title: Cross-Stitch by CraftGossip
feeds.description: Cross-Stitch patterns, reviews, techniques, and ideas by our expert Cross-Stitch editor. Started to help the burgeoning craft/DIY industry to have an outlet for the latest projects, ideas, techniques, and tools, CraftGossip is still the number one site for curated content that is picked, reviewed, and edited by our team of editors on a daily basis.

feeds.title: Lord Libidan
feeds.description: A self titled 'manbroiderer' (male embroiderer) I'm an internationally published cross stitch author and designer. I stitch video game and contemporary cross stitch, and try to break the mold, by taking a different look at the traditional cross stitch, such as playing with perspective, or making 3D transformers.

feeds.title: Studio Koekoek Blog
feeds.description: Tips and tricks to learn how to cross stitch. Sharing our love for cross stitch materials and patterns. Modern cross stitch blog written by designers.

feeds.title: Stitching Dreams
feeds.description: Stitching blog by Carol. I love getting to know fellow cross stitchers from around the world, discovering new stitching blogs, and being inspired by your work.

feeds.title: Pat's Cross-Stitch Corner
feeds.description: Explore a beautiful pastiche of Cross-sticked creations categorized into Blackbird Designs, Christmas Ornaments, Lady designs, Sampler, and more. Author Pat Geary has been passionate about Cross-stitching all her life and seeks to keep her art alive by educating people about it through her blog.

feeds.title: Cross Stitch and Diamond Painting Blog
feeds.description: Wizardi is a young and ambitious brand specialising in diamond painting, paint-by-number and 3D papercraft kits. Our company is the manufacturer of diamond painting kits on canvas and on plywood as well as paint by number kits. We also offer extensive range of cross stitch, plastic canvas and accessories for needlework. Our warehouse is located in USA, Minneapolis.

feeds.title: Garden Grumbles and Cross Stitch Fumbles
feeds.description: Run by Beth. I have resided in Lane County, Oregon most of my life, except while I attended Lewis and Clark College in Portland, Oregon. I enjoy gardening, cross stitching, reading, and genealogy.

feeds.title: Americana Cross-Stitch
feeds.description: A range of cross-stitch patterns based on images by Thomas Kinkade, Charles Wysocki, Linda Nelson Stocks etc.

feeds.title: Subversive Cross Stitch Blog
feeds.description: Subversive Cross Stitch began in the spring of 2003 as a form of anger management therapy when I was dealing with a bully of a boss. I stitched a few more pieces this way and started sharing the idea with friends through a simple website. Then, suddenly, my site was discovered and started getting a lot of press. So I quickly decided to offer this crafty form of therapy to others through kits.

feeds.title: Jane's Jottings
feeds.description: What am I to do with a life-long passion for stitching, the ability to sniff out an antique sampler a mile away, and an address book bursting with talented makers? I simply have to share and have an excuse to hunt out treasures for you and me! Welcome to my specially curated collection of treasures, some practical, some whimsical, some vintage, some bespoke, but all achingly desirable.

feeds.title: Caterpillar Cross Stitch Blog
feeds.description: Caterpillar Cross Stitch was launched by award-winning designer Sally Wilson in 2015 after she spent 9 months of pregnancy trying unsuccessfully to find a modern cross stitch kit for her new baby's modern neutral nursery. Sally and her team of 9, create by hand in rural Warwickshire, modern cross stitch kits, stitch-a-long projects, needle minders, and cross stitch patterns you won't find elsewhere!

feeds.title: Lindy Stitches Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Steph Webb, the designer behind Lindy Stitches. I dream up whimsical cross-stitch patterns and samplers that allow you to unleash that inner artist. Needles and colorful fibers give me a way to relax, meditate, and escape anxiety. I truly believe that every human was made to create, so I love making blueprints for creativity for others.

feeds.title: A Kiwi Stitching
feeds.description: Here, you'll discover up-to-date news, reviews, and tutorials on the latest cross cross stitch tools accessories and supplies.. We're here to help you have fun while you improve your cross stitching knowledge and skills.

feeds.title: Hannah Hand Makes Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Hannah Hand Makes; a place to explore cross stitch and creativity. I am a mum and know all about letting creativity slide during the overwhelm. I'm here to take away some of that overwhelm and bring you easy DIY tutorials to infuse more creativity into your life.

feeds.title: Dandelion Stitchery Blog
feeds.description: Hi, Friends! I'm so glad you're here! At Dandelion Stitchery, you'll find modern cross stitch patterns, kits, and cross stitch supplies plus embroidery keepsake gifts. All my designs can be completed in just a few days so you feel a wonderful sense of accomplishment with your finished project. I love the tranquility I feel when cross-stitching at the end of a stressful day!

feeds.title: Trouvaille Stitch Kits Blog
feeds.description: Trouvaille Stitch Kits are my ramblings about the world of cross stitch, new designs and the design process, and the local landmarks I've represented in my kits. The mission is to help you enjoy your cross-stitch journey while celebrating our wonderful British landmarks.

feeds.title: The Jolly Jabber Blog
feeds.description: The Jolly Jabber quilting blog not only offers resources for quilters but also for cross-stitchers of all skill levels. Discover resources such as tutorials, free patterns, and tips to help master the art of quilting and sewing.

feeds.title: Jo's Country Junction
feeds.description: Hello and WELCOME to Jo's Country Junction. I've been blogging here since 2009. That's a long time. Through the years readers have watched the lives of my family unfold from weddings to the gutting and remodeling of a foreclosure house, to farm life, to publishing quilts, to the births of grandchildren. I use my blog as somewhat of a journal and open it up and let you all in.

feeds.title: Sirious Stitches
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Gina, but I go by Sirithre, Siri, Cthylla, Steve, and a number of other names. I wanted to focus on welcoming the newer generation of stitchers who enjoy video games, pop culture, and bright colors. The goal is to help you apply this traditional medium to modern design.

feeds.title: The Twisted Stitcher
feeds.description: Run by Vonna Pfeiffer. I am an avid cross stitcher and I adore sharing my enthusiasm and love of stitching!

feeds.title: Lizzie*Kate Blog
feeds.description: Lizzie*Kate is a cross stitch design business that began in 1996. Follow us as we share some 'behind the scenes' stories about life, design, and of course, cross-stitch!

feeds.title: Liz Stitches
feeds.description: i stitch things. some for me, some for others. etsy/lizystitches

feeds.title: Drawings and Cross Stitch
feeds.description: Cross Stitching, Drawing, a little photography, and reading are all the things that get me through life without being bored. Storevny: www.storenvy.com/stores/759939-silver-feline-arts

feeds.title: Giraffe Crossing
feeds.description: Enjoy Delightful Cross-Stitch Patterns with a special focus on Giraffe-related themes and Cross Stitch tips. Giraffe Crossing is a little blog sharing beautiful little Cross stitch ideas and designs run by Theresa.

feeds.title: Frony Ritter Designs
feeds.description: This website is about making your life more creative with ideas for papercrafting, painting, beading and some cross stitch charts, some that are free and some that are for sale through distributors or your favorite needlework shop.

feeds.title: The Stitching Corner
feeds.description: Carrie's Cross Stitch blog is a place where she shares her finished projects, favorite products, stitching thoughts, and helpful tutorials for other stitchers.

feeds.title: Peacock & Fig Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Peacock & Fig! Whether it's through hand embroidery and cross stitch patterns that you stitch up yourself, the fabric you can sew your own projects with, or home decor products such as wallpaper and decorative cushions, Peacock & Fig's aim is to uplift you and your surroundings.

feeds.title: Notorious Needle
feeds.description: The Notorious Needle contains cross-stitch projects created for people like you (and me) who want to stitch the delightfully unexpected. I want to empower you to stitch whatever you want! Here you'll find patterns, inspiration, and tutorials to help you with your next cross-stitch project.

feeds.title: My Time Stitching
feeds.description: I am a wife to a wonderful, supportive husband and mother to two terrific boys. I love cross-stitching, knitting, stamping, and scrapbooking. I collect fabric, threads, paper, stamps as well as frogs and dolls. I have decided to start this blog as a way of documenting and sharing my love for cross-stitching and maybe some knitting and crocheting.

feeds.title: Stitch Wit Blog
feeds.description: Hello fellow Stitch Wit! I'm Heather, the main Stitch Wit behind all of this. I decided to put my web design, graphic design, business skills, and love for cross-stitching all together and created Stitch Wit. Stitch Wit is an online store and does not currently have a brick-and-mortar location (future goals!)

feeds.title: Stitches of Time » Cross Stitch
feeds.description: I have created this blog to share my interest in all forms of stitching, quilting, sewing, knitting, medieval re-enactment and costume making - particularly my love of historical embroidery. I also love travelling,especially when it also involves any of my other interests.

feeds.title: The World in Stitches Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! The World in Stitches supplies original cross stitch kits and patterns, handmade in Southend-on-Sea by me, Colleen Carrington. I make each kit with the best quality DMC or Zweigart fabrics, genuine DMC thread, and John James cross-stitch needles, and the color charts are printed on thick matte paper for readability and longevity.

feeds.title: Lpanne & Cross Stitch
feeds.description: I design cross-stitch patterns based on my nerdy interests. The only rules for using my patterns are that you credit me if you post a picture of something you've made, and don't sell anything made from my patterns.

feeds.title: Ribbon Forest Crafts
feeds.description: Bright and colorful resin jewelry, cross stitch pieces, clay figurines, and felt crafts by Becca!

feeds.title: Random Fandoms: The Cross Stitch Edition
feeds.description: Random fangirl, cross stitchin my fandoms.

feeds.title: Priscillas
feeds.description: Stitching with The Housewives Cross Stitch Designer .. cross stitch .. gardening..home decor with a farmhouse feel .. Thrift shopping

feeds.title: Waffle Flower Crafts Blog
feeds.description: StitchableCards is where cross-stitching meets cardmaking. It is made for the love of cross-stitching and cardmaking, one kit at a time.

feeds.title: Happiness is Cross Stitching
feeds.description: Run by Lynn. I love all types of crafts including cross stitch, crochet, knitting, dressmaking, polymer clay, card making, in fact as many types of crafts that I can get my hands on! I have given away many of my cross stitch pieces through give-aways on my blog and I offer many free cross stitch patterns for my readers to download.

feeds.title: Cross Stitch Progress
feeds.description: main blog: aubreebreepatterns are not mine unless claimed as such

feeds.title: Fangirl Stitches
feeds.description: Cross stitch patterns for the stitching geek

feeds.title: Little Stab Studios Blog
feeds.description: A cross stitch blog that has tutorials, unique finishing ideas, a connected youtube channel that has dozens of videos on how to design your own cross stitch pattern (with a focus on MacStitch/WinStitch software), free patterns, product reviews, and a special emphasis on Japan where I live with my mixed family and enjoy sharing cross stitch across cultures.

feeds.title: Curious Twist Blog
feeds.description: Here at Curious Twist our cross-stitch designs and kits are funny, quirky, snarky, and often very inappropriate. If you lean towards the unconventional and love to drop f-bombs like they're going out of fashion, then you're in the right place!
